title: The bounded prophetology and its census discipline
statement: The canon asserts a bounded prophetology — roughly forty guests at Yahweh's table, 'all beings representative of the religions created following our contacts,' with no list supplied — and warns in its own voice against false prophets; the corpus reads the two statements together as a methodological obligation: any reading of world religion through this canon must maintain an explicit, criteria-governed census of who is seated, with every seating an editorial decision the corpus can defend and revise.

includes: The canonical bound: the table scene's roughly-forty and its representative-of-created-religions criterion; the false-prophet warning as the canon's own control on inflation
The census discipline: seatings by explicit criteria, recorded and revisable — the method the Forty Chairs Explainer builds, riding on the sequence (woh-claim-0038) and its sub-class (woh-claim-0052)
The obligation reading, inferred: the canon does not command a census; the corpus infers that responsible use of a bounded, unlisted prophetology requires one
excludes: Any completed authoritative list; the census is a maintained instrument, not a delivered roster
Seating or unseating specific figures in this record; every seating is per-figure editorial work under the criteria
The number as exact; 'roughly forty' is carried at the canon's own precision
Living-claimants adjudication, which the false-prophet warning makes the corpus's most sensitive editorial ground and this record does not perform

source_references.locator: The table scene and its representative criterion; the false-prophet warning in the canon's own voice
The second message's development of the assembled representatives
The reception scholarship on prophetological boundary-work in new religious movements

alternatives.statement: A bounded, unlisted prophetology needs no census; the canon's silence on the list is the canon's answer, and the obligation is the corpus's invention.
Census criteria derived from the canon will seat whoever the canon's frame already favors; the instrument measures the frame, not the religions.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0038 or woh-claim-0052 is revised or retired.
The canon's fuller context changes the bound or the criterion.
Public prose begins publishing an authoritative roster or adjudicating living claimants, both of which this record excludes.
